title: Daily Chief Inspector Report
weather: 51°F partly cloudy (06:00) → 75°F clear (16:00); wind 1–15 mph; no precipitation
contractor: West Tech Energy — Jose Salaises, Director of Operations

sections.heading: Summary of the Day
paragraphs: West Tech worked Saturday with 8 personnel. Two welders completed 9 welds on 8-inch Class 150 piping (72 diameter-inches), and the civil crew completed layout of all concrete pillar locations in the combustion area, ready for excavation. Hydrovac excavation to 8 ft is scheduled to start Monday 11/23.

By email, Tegre answered the civil benchmark and elevation questions (forwarded by Joel Schweers; under review with West Tech). Joel sent the Encore manufacturing data book for the flare anchor bolt question and confirmed the guy wires use concrete block foundations per the Structural IFC, not the Encore helical anchors.

rows: Hot work (PPE, fire watch, fire prevention), housekeeping, and pre-excavation review: utility locates, permits, barricades, soil conditions and protective systems for 8 ft excavations.
